the walk stops resolving the CANDIDATE_PLANT_COMPONENT/AT_CONTROL_NODE chain or leaks other-facility siblings: component code, the three-name hierarchy, the self-exclusion and the 2-signal total are fixed fixture facts.

description bounding reverts to Cypher list slicing or drops the truncation flag: 3000-character descriptions must round-trip as the first 2048 characters with description_truncated true on items, signal, component and every hierarchy node.

the schema regains a required query, a raw query/cypher/endpoint key appears, or an absent designation becomes an error; the call_args.kwargs check at :76 is only a forwarding echo, not a guard.
a plant listing reaches the embedding path (the test fails the run) or the continuation dict regresses: the expected arguments dict is built independently with offset 1.
pagination bounds stop being enforced before the graph read, the page byte cap stops advancing by delivered items, or an oversized identity is silently truncated instead of refused.
